meta.title: Order service architecture
meta.sourceRef: QGraphFlow example: a fictional system that demonstrates graph data and interaction, not evidence from real source code

nodes.label: Client
nodes.subtitle: Sends order requests
facts: A fictional example that shows how to read node details.

nodes.label: Order service
nodes.subtitle: Validates requests and stores orders
facts: Writes order data and publishes an event to the queue; the example omits transactions and retry policy.

nodes.label: Order database
nodes.subtitle: Persists orders
facts: Stores order records; no particular database product is implied.

nodes.label: Event queue
nodes.subtitle: Carries order events
facts: Decouples order creation from the follow-up notification.

nodes.label: Notification service
nodes.subtitle: Consumes events and sends notifications
facts: Handles notifications asynchronously; a real system needs its own failure handling.
